_doc: Lane fractions measured in-game or stated by John. Key = internal-variant id prefix (matches every variant whose Id starts with it). lane_fraction = share of ONE belt lane a single building keeps up with; per_lane = ceil(1/lane_fraction). Anything not listed here and not derivable from the wiki is an open question for John (tools/rates.py --full lists them).

rows.note: belts keep up with a full lane
platform edge port, one per lane per floor
platform edge port, one per lane per floor
VN-20 v1 (2/lane) starved in-game; v2 (3/lane) keeps up with the belt
John's Clockwise platform uses 2 per lane; VN-20 v2 at 3/lane keeps up
mergers keep up with a full lane (John's rule: belts, splitters, mergers, ports = 1)
splitters keep up with a full lane (John's rule)
belt family = 1 lane; John's `For Claude Lifts.spz2bp` (2026-09-06) is the geometry reference for every Lift1/Lift2 Up/Down/Left variant
sink: accepts on all four sides, unlimited rate (wiki Trash page)
'Stackers, 6 per belt' -- John's `For Claude Stackers.spz2bp`: 1->6 fan of StackerStraight (rear inputs on both floors, front output). This is the wiki's plain milestone Stacker (ratio 6).
'Bent Stackers, 4 per belt' -- same blueprint: 1->4 fan of StackerDefault (output to the SIDE, local dir 3). This is the wiki's researched Stacker (Bent) (ratio 4).
John: 4 painters max out one belt; each delivers 45 shapes/min (0.75/s) and consumes 450 L/min of paint. Wiki level-5 row; sandbox is therefore at max upgrade level.
one belt in, three out (left/forward/right); the game balances exactly 1/3 per output. Used in his VN-02 variant (blueprints/reference/For Claude VN-02 1to3 splitter.spz2bp)
three in (behind/left/right), one out; the 1->3 butterfly's merge half

full_space_belt.note: A Full Space Belt (FSB) delivers 48 belts of throughput: 4 ports on a platform, each 12 belts (3 levels of 4). Matches the wiki (space-belt lane = 4 belts, 12 lanes).

scope.note: Sandbox allows crystals, but the MAM target is basic shapes + painting first; crystals (Crystal Generator, 6/lane) come after.

upgrade_level.note: Painter at 45/min = wiki level-5 column (belt 180/min). Design to the wiki's top-level row / the 'ratio' column for every machine.

paint_supply.note: One full belt of painting needs 4 x 450 = 1800 L/min, i.e. exactly one Fluid Launcher/Catcher at level 5 (wiki: 1800 L/min) per painted belt.
